# ISpeechRecognitionService

**Interface** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Core/ISpeechRecognitionService.cs#L10)

What the framework expects of a speech recognition module: turn what the trainee says into
text, and say when it is listening. Matching that text against something a scene expects to
hear is not part of this - that is what a phrase component does with
[`OnFinalResult`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/ISpeechRecognitionService#onfinalresult). Obtained from [`RuntimeRegistry`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/RuntimeRegistry).

```csharp
public interface ISpeechRecognitionService
```

**Derived:** [`SpeechRecognitionManager`](/api/vrframework-speech-runtime/SpeechRecognitionManager)

## Properties

### CanListen {#canlisten}

True once the recogniser has a model loaded and can be asked to listen. False while the
model is still being prepared, which on Android means a copy out of the APK.

## Methods

### StartListening() {#startlistening}

Starts feeding audio to the recogniser. Does nothing while [`CanListen`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/ISpeechRecognitionService#canlisten) is
false, so a scene may call it before the model has finished loading.

```csharp
void StartListening()
```

[View source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Core/ISpeechRecognitionService.cs#L25)

### StopListening() {#stoplistening}

Stops feeding audio to the recogniser, discarding anything half heard.

```csharp
void StopListening()
```

## Events

### OnFinalResult {#onfinalresult}

A settled piece of speech, raised once the recogniser hears the end of it. This is the one
to act on.

```csharp
event Action<string> OnFinalResult
```

**Returns** `Action<string>`

[View source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Core/ISpeechRecognitionService.cs#L40)

### OnPartialResult {#onpartialresult}

The text so far, raised repeatedly as someone speaks and revised as the recogniser
changes its mind. Useful for showing what is being heard, never for deciding anything.

```csharp
event Action<string> OnPartialResult
```

**Returns** `Action<string>`
